from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import pytest
from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_business_policy import prepare_reading_business_assessment
from company_wiki.source_catalog import narrative_source_context
from company_wiki.source_catalog.reading_recipe import business_algorithm_hashes

@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", (
 "We aim to reopen neonatal wards and create value.",
 "We are committed to treating rare diseases and creating value.",
))
def test_concrete_coordinated_operation_cannot_be_erased_by_abstract_tail(text):
    value = prepare_reading_business_assessment(text, {"relations": []})
    assert value.passage.relevant and value.passage.use == "support"
    assert not value.fact.eligible

@pytest.mark.parametrize("pdf", (False, True))
def test_new_source_context_is_bound_by_actual_ast_recipe(monkeypatch, pdf):
    path = Path(narrative_source_context.__file__).resolve()
    name = "company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_source_context"
    before = business_algorithm_hashes(pdf_frontend=pdf)
    original = Path.read_bytes
    assert before[name] == hashlib.sha256(original(path).replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest()
    def changed(file):
        raw = original(file)
        return raw+b"\n# independent source context mutation\n" if file.resolve() == path else raw
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_bytes", changed)
    assert business_algorithm_hashes(pdf_frontend=pdf)[name] != before[name]
